messages:
sahil: Alert — seeing delayed telemetry ingestion for EU region; agg-hour rows missing for 2026-03-18 02:00–05:00 UTC. Likely downstream consumer replays will be large. Thoughts on priority/backfill?
telemetry-bot: Alert created: EU-ingest-late-2142001234. Missing count: ~18k agg rows. Investigate: ingest queue spikes at 02:12 UTC.
laizen: Do we know if this is from late producers or our Kafka/Redpanda lag? Any offsets showing gaps?
dave: I dug into offsets — producer offsets are continuous; consumer lag spiked due to a zonal autoscaler flapping. Suggest run targeted replay for affected partitions instead of full reprocess.
ying: +1 for targeted. We should also ensure recompute job respects SLO and doesn't blow quotas. Can we add a priority lane with throttled concurrency?
marie: We have backfill windows today at 18:00 UTC. If we run now, it will compete. Proposal: create 'telemetry-priority' queue with quota 15% of compute for next 6 hours.
sahil: Good. How do we wire that to replay controller? dave, can you post the job command?
dave: run:
```bash
# replay only partitions 12-19 for eu-2026-03-18
rctl replay --env prod --topic telemetry-eu --partitions 12-19 \
  --since "2026-03-18T02:00:00Z" --until "2026-03-18T05:00:00Z" \
  --queue telemetry-priority --concurrency 4 --rate 2500
```
laizen: Need TTL dedupe window check. If we replay overlapping data we must ensure idempotency.
ying: I'll add a short feature flag in controller to gate aggressive dedupe. + I'll patch the console quota UI to show telemetry-priority usage.
ops-bot: Scheduled replay job 2142001305 by dave on telemetry-priority — status: queued.
marie: Assigning owner: ying for dedupe guard; dave for running replay; laizen to monitor SLOs; sahil to notify customers if lag persists.
sahil: Great — checkin 2142001600 for completion; if not done by +6h escalate to oncall.
